units.title: Introduction
topics: Basic elements – Types of electric drives – Factors influencing the choice of electrical drives – Heating and cooling curves – Loading conditions and classes of duty – Selection of power rating for drive motors with regard to thermal overloading and load variation factors

units.title: Motor Characteristics
topics: Mechanical characteristics – Speed –Torque characteristics of various types of load and drive motors – Braking of Electrical motors – DC motors – Shunt – Series – Compound – Single phase and three phase induction motors

units.title: Starting Methods
topics: Types of D.C motor starters – Typical control circuits for shunt and series motors –Three phase squirrel cage and slip ring induction motors

units.title: Conventional And Solid State Speed Control Of D.C. Drives
topics: Speed control of DC series and shunt motors – Armature and field control –Ward- Leonard control system – Using controlled rectifiers and DC choppers – Applications

units.title: Conventional And Solid State Speed Control Of A.C. Drives
topics: Speed control of three phase induction motor – Voltage control – Voltage / frequency control – Slip power recovery scheme – Using inverters and AC voltage regulators – Applications
